conf.description: Cisco Duo MFA telephony / api-pull: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: cisco-duo / telephony / api-pull. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Cisco Duo integration (telephony_v2 data stream)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
